title: Partner Marketing Hub Just Got Smarter!
subject: Your Partner Marketing Hub just got smarter
body:
The Hitachi Vantara Partner Marketing Hub just got smarter. Find the right resources faster, personalize content for your customers and go from a marketing idea to a ready-to-launch campaign in minutes.

What’s new?

• Create campaigns faster with AI. Turn your marketing goals into ready-to-launch campaigns with AI assistance. Save time on planning and content creation.

• Launch co-branded campaigns in a few clicks. Activate prebuilt workflows that automatically apply your branding, or use AI to tailor the content to your business and audience.

• Your marketing tools. Our campaigns. Seamlessly connected. Already using Marketo, HubSpot or Mailchimp? Bring approved Hitachi Vantara campaign content into your existing marketing platform, so you can leverage our campaigns without rebuilding content or changing how your marketing team works.
Explore marketing platform integrations: https://partnermarketing.hitachivantara.com/platform/integration-service

• Focus on your best opportunities. Keep audiences up to date with automated Smart Lists. Use lead scoring to identify the prospects showing the most interest and prioritize sales follow-up.

• Use campaign insights to improve your next outreach. Track performance, see how customers engage and use AI-powered insights to optimize your marketing efforts.

Discover the new experience: https://partnermarketing.hitachivantara.com/home

Which customer audience would you like to reach first? Reply with your goal and I’ll help you choose a campaign to launch.

Questions? partner.marketing.team@hitachivantara.com
